description: Code-behind file for the StartExam page in an online examination system, managing session validation, course selection based on user semester, and exam initiation logic for theory and MCQ exams.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam WebForm, handling user session validation, course list population based on semester, and initiating exams.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, checks user login session, and populates course list based on user's semester.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to User Profile page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Begins the selected exam after validating the exam type and course, sets relevant session variables, and prepares for the exam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Checks if the student has already taken a theory exam for selected course, and navigates to the exam if not.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Checks if the student has already taken an MCQ exam for selected course, and navigates to the exam if not.
